text: No single set of writing principles serves all organizational writing genres.
The plainspoken repository skill is scoped to chat/conversational register and is not a general-purpose document-writing technique.

Readability-formula optimization (Hemingway Editor) is the weakest technique on evidence grounds because grade-level scoring measures surface features that can mislead in organizational and scientific writing.

Blameless postmortem convention deliberately suppresses individual-level accountability language, which is a feature for postmortems but a defect in decision records and other genres requiring visible agency.
ASD-STE100 and the ste repository skill damage persuasive force and are poorly suited to dissent, argumentation, and nuanced decision writing.
The humanize skill's default Pass 1 instruction to 'take a position' strips calibrated hedges and damages confidence calibration, though science/paper overrides restore it.

Incident notification while facts are still moving is the genre most underserved by the available techniques, because no single technique simultaneously handles brevity, real-time confidence calibration, empathy, and accessibility.

Decision records for future readers not present at the time of the decision are underserved because no available technique mandates capturing alternatives considered, decision criteria, trade-offs, dissent, reversibility, and expiring assumptions.

Toulmin argumentation and the Minto Pyramid Principle are complementary rather than competing: Pyramid places the claim on top while Toulmin describes the grounds, warrant, backing, qualifier, and rebuttal beneath it.
STE and plain language ISO 24495-1 do not combine well within a single document because STE's controlled vocabulary is stricter than plain language requires.
The Amazon six-page narrative memo damages brevity by design, trading it for depth, shared context, and durability.
BLUF and Pyramid structures can suppress confidence calibration by forcing a stable top-line claim when the honest answer is still uncertain.

Most organizational writing techniques rest primarily on institutional adoption and practitioner consensus rather than experimental evidence; plain language and Toulmin argumentation have the strongest experimental support.
The humanize skill helps accountability by flagging agentless constructions such as 'studies show' without citation.

Dissent writing that must be both maximally persuasive and durable for a later reader inside a hierarchical organization is underserved because no available technique handles the interpersonal/empathy load alongside the argumentative requirements.
Techniques should be applied sequentially by level—structural method first, then sentence-level constraints, then word-level passes—rather than blended simultaneously.
ASD-STE100 and the ste skill damage accountability by favoring agentless passives and imperative-only constructions that obscure who acts.
The postmortem genre has a negative demand for individual accountability because blameless convention deliberately hides individual agency to make honest reporting safe.
The Hemingway Editor penalizes qualifying clauses and subordinate structures that carry calibrated uncertainty, making it actively harmful for scientific and precision-dependent writing.
Reference and onboarding documentation is the genre best served by ASD-STE100 or the ste repository skill because it was the genre STE was originally designed for.

Hotaling's rules for concise scientific writing rest on practitioner consensus and alignment with broader scientific writing advice rather than direct experimental validation of the specific rule set.
The humanize repository skill's AI-tells catalog is a practitioner heuristic derived from community-assembled lists and has not been validated as a reliable detector of AI authorship.
A genre-first selection procedure—diagnosing demand profile before choosing technique—is the correct organizing principle for matching writing methods to organizational documents.
The Amazon PR-FAQ format improves customer focus by forcing a working-backwards framing from user value.
Brevity and durability are in direct tension because a skim-friendly document that omits context becomes harder for later readers to interpret.
Classical argumentation and Toulmin-style argument structures damage accessibility for non-specialist readers.
